Validate reply/remix scope; support slow replies, clear declines, private reminders, quiet observation, overwhelm break and reversible return without social debt.
Show camera/speaking expectations, duration, preparation, sensory conditions, text/async alternative, quiet buddy and easy exit before joining.
Test unsolicited critique, revoked remix permission, ignored reply, quiet participation and re-entry; blocking/reporting remains available and no safety preference exposes a diagnosis.

Publish purposeful gaps, small offered contributions, preview/accept/reject and branch comparison; text-equivalent placeholders work while billing-dependent media storage is unavailable.

Test rejected changes, competing branches, creator exit, revocation, disputed credit, deletion and derivative retention; make limits visible instead of promising impossible removal from external copies.
Design small consented visits between interest circles: inquire, contrast, collect, return with an artifact; scope guide authority, accessibility, time and permission to quote.
Persist invite, opt-in, role choice, check-in, return and closure; complementary roles instigator, maker, connector, editor, researcher and host are flexible, not personality labels.
Offer short alternating creative turns, quiet roles, accessible summaries and no forced DM; fallback to existing community resources if another circle is unavailable.
Test declined participation, missing guide, cultural disagreement, appropriation concerns and uncredited borrowing; assess useful new perspective without maximizing outsider traffic.
Model collaboration cards with role, effort, availability, pay, ownership and outcome; separate five-minute feedback, quiet twenty-minute companionship, volunteer gifts and professional services.
Accept, scope, renegotiate, cancel and complete offers with recipient authority, expiry and limits; gifting creates no implicit debt, sales pitch or forced reciprocity.
Let people offer a skill, idea, question or quiet presence and find bounded complementary requests; expose unpaid/paid terms before contact and preserve refusal.
Test oversubscribed requests, exploitative unpaid work, stale availability, cancellation and organizer overload; contextual thanks do not turn help into a global reputation score.
Specify a mystery with researcher, sketcher, storyteller and quiet observer routes; allow multiple answers, asynchronous play, clear end and no mandatory competitive scoreboard.
Persist discoveries, retries and shared revelations without punishment for absence; deterministic fixtures handle one participant, dropout, late join and stalled clues.
Ship changing member-remixed constraints, jokes and sensory-aware celebrations with content boundaries; laughter is opt-in and never targets vulnerability.
Exercise quiet completion, skipped celebration, alternative solution, timeout and restart; basic access remains open without playing and no public failure shame occurs.
Nodes recognize making, welcoming, hosting, repair and useful cross-circle contribution; evidence can be private, self-chosen and corrected. No universal person score or diagnosis.
Support skill branches, build changes, rest, contribution withdrawal and shared artwork/tool unlocks; unequal capacity never causes guilt or locks basic participation.
Offer creative-chemistry milestones for an actual artifact, renewed idea or inclusive gathering; show contribution context and optional celebration, not contact counts.
Test spam, self-dealing, invisible care, quiet contributors, mistaken credit and revoked evidence; ensure cosmetic unlocks do not become exclusionary status or mandatory streaks.
Differentiate opinion, choose, change-my-mind, missing-perspective and version polls; resource annotations state when useful, limitations and actual application, with source/credit.
Implement poll closure, reasons, decisions, accepted insight and corrected annotations without silently converting disagreement into consensus.
Support obscure-interest collections, meme-to-inquiry links, request-a-resource and accessible summaries; no popularity-only sorting or fabricated source authority.
Test disputed evidence, withdrawn annotation, misleading resource, harmful joke and reopened decision; credit persists appropriately while removed material loses visibility.
Move interest to feasible scheduling, role commitment and confirmed event; specify small, quiet, online and asynchronous formats, cancellation and timezone behavior.
Persist roles, preparation, accessibility, attendance limits, consented reminders and handover; never display unconfirmed interest as a booked event.
Expose first-timer preview, buddy option, host expectations and leave action; follow-up creates a permissioned artifact and optional continuation rather than group-chat obligation.
Test no-shows, host departure, abusive attendee, over-capacity, timezone shift and inaccessible venue; review actual attendance/helpfulness and care load separately.
Offer unfinished-work fair, forgotten-projects museum, school of odd skills and seasonal closure; members choose gifts, exhibitions, quiet presence and whether to preserve or let go.
Assemble approved places, event seeds and artifacts into a bounded program with host/care shifts, capacity, licenses and published closing time.
Welcome newcomers and honor stopped projects without pressured disclosure, spiritual claims, pay-to-belong or reciprocity debt; equivalent async/text access is available.
Test cancellation, quiet-only participation, unwanted archival, overworked hosts and a paused project return; retain only approved artifacts and attributable collective history.
Distinguish familiar face, quiet buddy, collaborator, feedback friend and public follow; shared artifacts and next-encounter intentions require explicit reciprocal scope where appropriate.
Store selected shared milestones and links with correction, export, unlink and deletion; no inferred emotional bond or hidden affinity score.
Offer one bounded follow-up or keep-public option; show reply expectations and let either person decline or simply leave without debt.
Test one-sided unlink, blocks, obsolete commitment, facet changes and stale relationship recap; never pressure private messaging or reveal another person’s private notes.
Specify trained host/moderator scope, response expectations, escalation, appeals, pseudonym accountability, adult-dating boundaries and unhosted-state limits; peer care is not clinical treatment.
Integrate report, block, containment, evidence minimization, conflict-of-interest reassignment and appeal with access controls; no public victim disclosure or mandatory mediation.
Provide boundary-setting, clarified intent and chosen repair only when safe; preserve exit, non-response and separate care support; avoid coercive reconciliation rituals.
Run tabletop targeted harassment, stalking across facets, hostile remix, brigading, facilitator misuse and host burnout; record response/recovery evidence and unresolved staffing gates.
Members propose culture questions and time-limited changes with impact, rollback, eligibility and decision authority; prohibit popularity vote overriding individual consent or safety.
Implement accessible deliberation, conflict declarations, decision logs and revision triggers; distinguish representative input from unanimous agreement.
Offer anonymous-to-publication feedback through accountable moderation, quiet input and artifact-based community history with corrections and permissioned visibility.
Test capture by high-volume posters, excluded newcomers, moderator conflict and failed experiment; assess who benefits, who bears care work and how rollback restores rights.

Default AI participation off; permit explicit per-action idea translation, cross-discipline prompts, event routing and consented discussion summaries. No simulated friends, identity voices or private-data discovery.
Enforce allowed inputs, recipient consent, attribution, capability/budget limits and remove/disable paths; do not transmit private notes, assessment or therapist context.
Show inputs, generated label, editable result and human publish decision; fallback manual templates if no model service is available within existing budget.
Test malicious public prompt, invented credit, summary disagreement, off-state, consent withdrawal and unavailable model; AI output never masquerades as a participant or community decision.
Extend authored Felt/loading identity into plush places and artifact galleries; require licensing, consistent orientation and accessible text descriptions, without fake online crowds.
Use approved collective artifacts in modular world scenes with payload limits, reduced-motion/static versions and independent sound, motion, texture and density controls.
Ensure text view has equal discovery, collaboration and return actions; preserve preferences across devices and do not hide safety controls behind spatial navigation.
Collect trace/payload budgets, keyboard/screen-reader checks and actual-device measurements for new views; retain existing phone report only as tested and fine, not new measured evidence.

requirements.requirement: Concentrated cold start and healthy liquidity
subrequirements: Pick one or two creative niches and bounded hosted windows with seed artifacts, real host capacity and clear empty states; no fabricated members, posts or activity.
Provide solo making, useful resources, scheduled encounters and consented invitations when matching is empty; bound requests and avoid repeatedly burdening the same helpers.
Plan launch rituals, five-minute contributions, quiet pathways, co-organizing handoffs and opt-in invitations; external contact requires actual authorization and participants.

Exercise useful encounter, failed-match and host-load fixtures against preregistered expand/iterate/pause rules; verify genuine observations remain pending for P07/G02 and are never replaced by fixture outcomes.
Estimate moderation/hosting/tool costs and organizer effort; compare optional membership, paid workshops and creator tools while protecting free basic participation.
Define paid versus gift offers, fees/refunds, organizer compensation and conflict disclosures; no sale of sensitive data, pay-to-belong pressure or covert sponsorship.
Implement only no-charge labels and transparent cost mockups initially; Spark quota planning excludes billing-dependent media storage and any new paid provider activation.

Exercise cost, fairness, accessibility and free-participation scenarios; prepare a genuine consented viability protocol for P07/G02. No fixture establishes willingness to pay; live payment, billing or commercial commitments require separate concrete authorization.

Operationalize useful artifacts, valued connections, felt welcome, capability growth, offline benefit and unequal care burden; distinguish self-report, behavior and inference, no therapy-efficacy claim.
Track bounded funnel and optional follow-up with purposes, retention, withdrawal and research consent; avoid private message content, diagnostic inference and individual social scoring.
Compare meaningful outcomes, inappropriate suggestions, abandoned collabs, host load and quiet access with baselines; missing participants or follow-up remains visibly pending.

Use explicitly synthetic findings to exercise adverse-outcome, uncertainty and accessibility review; link proposed changes to Beads and retain negative evidence. Genuine pilot findings and accept/iterate/pause decisions belong to P01–P09/G02, not this pre-pilot verification.

pilots.title: Quiet newcomer to collaborative exhibition
pilots.scenario: A tired newcomer chooses two minutes, contributes one sentence to a miniature city, optionally meets a sound artist and later attends or asynchronously views an exhibition; record friction, consent and useful outcome.

pilots.title: Meme becomes consequential public collaboration
pilots.scenario: A meme becomes a poll, accepted idea and confirmed small event; audience expansion is reviewed, credits survive and follow-up artifact is permissioned.

pilots.title: Cross-disciplinary remix expedition
pilots.scenario: Consenting poet, sound artist and illustrator make branches and return an artifact; test declined match, role flexibility, credit, changed availability and relationship unlink.

pilots.title: Quiet asynchronous cooperative mystery
pilots.scenario: Solve through multiple roles and answers with no camera, quiet observer, dropout and late return; compare playfulness, agency and comprehension without forced streaks.

pilots.title: Member-built finite festival
pilots.scenario: Run a small hosted odd-skills/unfinished-work program with quiet routes, host succession and deliberate closure; measure enjoyment, accessible participation and actual care burden.

pilots.title: Governance, credit conflict and repair tabletop
pilots.scenario: Independently simulate unauthorized remix, brigading, AI-authorship ambiguity, unsafe reconciliation and captured vote; record containment, appeal and rollback without exposing participants.

pilots.title: Sparse launch and sustainable care trial
pilots.scenario: Evaluate a genuinely small community with missing matches, unpaid/paid boundary previews and constrained hosts; observe usefulness before growth and inspect free-access fairness.

pilots.title: Measured phone and assistive-technology journey
pilots.scenario: Measure the new integrated journey on an actual phone and with applicable assistive technology; distinguish measured traces, emulation, expert inspection and participant feedback.

pilots.scenario: Follow up at preregistered intervals about chosen connections, completed work and real-world usefulness, plus harms and exclusions; preserve non-response, withdrawal and uncertainty.
